title: Machine execution for an emitter instruction suffix
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean list, let $k$ be a gate kind, let $c$ be one of $0,1,2$, and let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|w|+2$ positions. Let $v$ assign a natural number to each of three work tapes, and suppose every value of $v$ is at most $M$. For any instruction list $r$ and program counter $pc<64$ such that the program for $(k,c)$ starting at $pc$ is exactly $r$, and any output list $o$, there are a time $T\le |r|(2M+3)$ and a program counter $p_e<64$ at which the program has ended such that, after $T$ steps from the configuration in emission state $(k,c,pc)$ with input-head position $p$, unary tapes and heads specified by $v$, and output $o$, the machine is in emission state $(k,c,p_e)$ with the same input position, tapes, and heads, and output $o$ followed by the execution of $r$ under $v$.
hypotheses_covered: An input-head position $p$ among the $|w|+2$ valid positions
A natural number $M$ with $v(t)\le M$ for every component $t$
An instruction list $r$ and program counter $pc<64$
